decisions.summary: Wave 87 takes a pre-existing defect (not a ranked row) under constitution XIV: the fabric every way is threaded by (_homestead_polys) omitted the parts held until drawn, so seed 906's track out was laid over a held well pocket and refused by the matrix
decisions.why: Adds work and narrows nothing. The request is to make the implementation match the research; the fabric already counts drawn wells and fixtures and the overlap matrix already forbids a lane on them, so the fix makes an existing rule hold in the window between seating and drawing. The project's standing rule (XIV; GM 2026-10-01) has defects found in the work fixed in that work, and the plan has done so before (waves at plan lines 552, 828). The unit is under hamletgen/, inside FR-010's scope. No ranked row is skipped or re-tiered by it.

decisions.summary: Held parts enter the fabric as they will be drawn: a well pocket as the octagon at max(r, vr), each other held record with x, y, w, h (farm fixtures, retirement houses) as its box, unrotated
decisions.why: The same representation the fabric already uses for the drawn wells, and the held record's own form (held_part_records carries no rot; the matrix judges that same record). Pure implementation of the fix; it narrows nothing.

decisions.summary: Verification: the test red before the fix, seed 906 and the 48-seed cohort (48 -> 49/54, none newly failing), the pool rerolled (no map moved), impl-drift on the claims owed (T203), spec-fidelity; the gate, timing pair and occasions at batch 11's close
decisions.why: FR-005's batched verification exactly. The reviewer re-rolled seed 906 on the uncommitted engine (make cohort N=1 SEED=906: 7/7 passed) and the test file (17 passed). No new element or glyph, so no review occasion is owed.
